items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And then after I went and worked with him on Wisconsin Roof, why, I had a great admiration for him.

ctx.x: He got to be a drinker.

Is that... Yeah, he got drank too much because he wrote a couple numbers and I raised them for him. And we were at the house and... And I didn't know he had that much talent. And he played them on the horn and I think I missed a note or something. And he... And he handled his voice. And he told me this was a note I had missed. And I didn't know the guy had the most talents because I didn't think he could read too fast, you know. But he was surprisingly much better than I thought he was. And then after I went and…
You mentioned Cass. Do you recall now any of the other fellows there?
